component.name: ToolCheckout
component.summary: Fast, accountable tool loans for a repair shop

description.p: ToolCheckout tracks who has which tool at a repair shop. It runs on the shared counter PC, works fully offline and needs no server.

ul.li: Check out in about three taps: scan a tool, scan or pick the borrower, confirm with a PIN
Technicians inspect returns; a tool that comes back worse opens a damage incident
Overdue tools stand out, with desktop notifications and an end-of-day reminder
Hash-chained audit log, reports as CSV or printouts, Code 128 asset labels
Daily automatic backups, restore, and a demo mode with sample data
